notes: Qt 6.4.2; scene graph backend=default/RHI (graphicsApi enum 1); platform=xcb. frame_ms = interval between consecutive QQuickWindow::frameSwapped emissions (software: after QSGSoftwareRenderLoop rendered the dirty regions and flushed the QBackingStore to X (xcb/SHM); RHI/GL: after swapBuffers returned on the render thread); QT_QPA_UPDATE_IDLE_TIME=0 (Qt default 5 ms pacing of update requests removed unless --paced); redraw requested continuously (window->update() from a queued tick after every frameSwapped; no vsync/timer pacing). First 2 s warm-up discarded (scripts restart at t=0). List = QML ListView (reuseItems, cacheBuffer 600) over C++ QAbstractListModel (rows computed in data()); delegate height = row height role; ListView estimates contentHeight for variable heights so scripted offsets are in exact sum-of-heights space but contentY is clamped to the ListView estimate. rows_drawn = number of data(TitleRole) calls (delegate creations + reuse rebinds).
